title: compact experiment labpad - selene
content:
Purpose: personal quick-run ledger for small experiments (fast iteration). Use as scratch sheet before moving to shared tracking.

Quick notes:
- Trying 4-bit quant + KV cache warmup heuristics for conversational workload.
- Want p95 < 180ms for short prompts (<= 128 tokens) at batch=1.
- Track cost roughly (usd per 1k tokens) from local run estimates.

Table: recent runs (compact)
(date | id | model | quant | batch | seq | p50_ms | p95_ms | tps | est_cost_per_1k_usd | perf_label | notes)
2024-10-04 | s24-001 | llama3-70b | 4-bit | 1 | 64 | 68 | 145 | 12.4 | 0.95 | baseline, kv cold
2024-10-06 | s24-002 | llama3-70b | 4-bit | 1 | 128 | 82 | 190 | 9.1 | 1.05 | p95 slipped, re-run with warmup
2024-10-07 | s24-003 | llama3-70b | 4-bit+kv | 1 | 128 | 76 | 158 | 9.8 | 1.03 | KV warm, better p95
2024-10-12 | s24-010 | mix-7b | 8-bit | 4 | 64 | 42 | 78 | 28.6 | 0.22 | cheap, good for high qps tests
2024-11-01 | s24-021 | llama3-70b | 4-bit | 2 | 64 | 115 | 230 | 20.3 | 0.88 | batch=2 increased throughput but p95 bad
2024-11-07 | s24-027 | llama3-70b | 4-bit+kv | 2 | 64 | 98 | 162 | 23.1 | 0.92 | try adjusted batching heuristic

Quick observations:
- Short seqs (<=64) consistently hit p95 < 170ms with KV warm.
- Batch>1 improves tokens/sec but can push p95 beyond acceptable for interactive use.
- 4-bit quant is ok cost-wise but watch p95 tail variability.

Open todos (personal):
- [ ] Add simple script to flush KV only when model/version changes (prevent unnecessary cache misses).
- [ ] Run localized sweep for prompt-length distribution from prod-sampled traces (pull 1k sessions). Jira: JIRA-MLINF-482
- [ ] Try input-prefetch for batch=2 to see if scheduling reduces p95 spikes.

Scratch config snippets (notes to self):
- run command (local): run_infer --model llama3-70b --quant 4 --batch 1 --seq 128 --warm-kv 1 --capture-metrics /tmp/s24-003.json
- cost calc heuristic: tokens_per_sec -> tokens_per_min -> (tokens_per_min * 60) / 1000 * cost_per_1k_usd_est

Quick links + references:
- PR with batching heuristic: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/219
- Eval notebook (internal): confluence/redwood/evals/short-prompt-latency (TODO: add link)

Notes to self (messy):
- If p95 keeps jumping on 70b after warm, check GPU mem fragmentation and cudnn cudart messages in logs — saw a weird transient on 2024-10-06.
- Keep these mini-sheets lightweight; move stable runs to shared_drives/engineering/applied-ml/runs/ when validated.

End of sheet.
